entries.190019fa5474109f: The company manufactures specialty chemicals and environmental products, including textile treatment agents, defoamers, cosmetic raw materials, heavy metal collectors, heavy metal fixatives and other surfactants, and sells them to customers and sales agents. The consolidated subsidiary MIYOSHI OIL & FAT MALAYSIA SDN.BHD. was established by the company to strengthen production of glycerin-based products, and is building a manufacturing base in Malaysia.
entries.39cdb810fcadb097: The company manufactures industrial oils and fats, various fatty acids, glycerin, industrial soap and other industrial oils and fats, and sells them to customers and sales agents. The equity-method affiliate Sekisei T&C Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells cosmetics and other products, partly using the company's fatty acids as raw materials.
entries.5c21d36471c82ed8: This is a business segment not included in the reportable segments, and includes real estate leasing, raw material oils and fats and others.
entries.5d460938909dadae: Industrial oils and fats and fatty acids
entries.809dfc936805c9c9: The company manufactures margarine, shortening, lard, powdered oils and fats, whipped cream and other processed edible oils and fats, and sells them to customers and sales agents. This sales agent includes the consolidated subsidiary Miyoshi Shoji Co., Ltd.
entries.83dfbc7226fa69c5: This is a reportable segment engaged in the manufacture and sale of industrial oils and fats, various fatty acids, specialty chemicals and others.
entries.8f2e655a5bbf38a9: Logistics and raw material supply, etc.
entries.9f213189d91a77e5: The affiliate AAK Miyoshi Japan Co., Ltd. was established under a joint venture agreement that the company concluded with AAK, a Swedish company, when entering the chocolate fat business.
entries.b3089110561f4fb4: The consolidated subsidiary Miyoshi Butsuryu Co., Ltd. handles logistics for the company's products, the unconsolidated subsidiary Miyoshi Kyoei Co., Ltd. mainly supplies raw materials to the company, and the equity-method affiliate Nihon Tank Terminal Co., Ltd. mainly runs warehousing and port transport businesses handling oil and fat raw materials, among others.
entries.c511d58588e3a878: This is a reportable segment engaged in the manufacture and sale of edible oils and fats. The company group consists of the company, 4 subsidiaries, 3 affiliates and 2 related parties (major shareholders), and its main business is the manufacture and sale of edible oils and fats based on natural oils and fats, industrial oils and fats, various fatty acids, specialty chemicals, environmental products and others.
entries.f6fb5a06075a5d64: A materials manufacturer that uses natural fats and oils as raw materials to make and sell edible processed fats and oils such as margarine, and oleochemical products such as fatty acids and surfactants.
